body:
First slice of #129. That PR is too large to review, so it is being split into a stack of smaller PRs merged bottom-up. This is the base of that stack — it is the first four commits of the branch, unmodified, so no rebasing or cherry-picking was involved.

## What's here

| Commit | Change |
|---|---|
| `d6a40f1d` | `update scons usage` — Python 3 / modern SCons compatibility; drops the hand-rolled Darwin `TOOL_BUNDLE` bundle builder in favour of SCons' built-in support |
| `728adc1f` | `fix zlib usage bugs` — error handling in `FileManager`, `StreamBackend`, `StreamFilter`, `MapThumbnail` |
| `eeb66980` | `switch from boost threads to std threads` |
| `61cf0970` | `Replace boost::shared_ptr, lexical_cast, and tuple with C++11 equivalents` |

The boost work is mechanical substitution: 22 `boost/shared_ptr.hpp`, 4 `boost/thread/thread.hpp`, 3 `boost/tuple/tuple.hpp`, 3 `boost/thread/recursive_mutex.hpp`, 2 `boost/lexical_cast.hpp`, 1 each of `weak_ptr.hpp` and `tuple_comparison.hpp` swapped for `<memory>`, `<thread>`, `<mutex>`, `<tuple>`, `<string>`. 186 files, +1290/−1226, and the line counts are dominated by include churn.

## Notes for the reviewer

- **This does not remove the boost dependency.** It removes the smart-pointer, thread, `lexical_cast` and `tuple` surface. `SConstruct` still links `-lboost_date_time`, and `libgag/src/Sprite.cpp`, `src/Utilities.h`, `src/AIEcho.h` and several YOG headers still include boost. Dropping boost entirely is not in scope here.
- **`CLAUDE.md` is added by `d6a40f1d`** (107 lines, agent/contributor build notes). It rode along with the SCons commit. Happy to strip it into its own commit or drop it if you'd rather it not land here — say the word.
- **`test/SConstruct`** gets a one-line fix: `sys.platform == "linux2"` never matches under Python 3 (which reports `linux`), so the test build fell through to the MSVC `else` branch on every platform. This fixes Linux. macOS still falls through to `/EHsc /MD /GR` and does not build — pre-existing, fixed later in the stack.

## Test plan

- [x] `scons release=1 -j16` clean build on macOS arm64 (Darwin 25.6) — exit 0, no errors
- [x] Runtime smoke: `./build/src/glob2 -test-games-nox` ran two complete AI games to natural end (26,594 and 23,650 ticks) across Castor / Nicowar / Numbi / Warrush, with no asserts, aborts, or uncaught exceptions — exercises the swapped threading and smart-pointer paths under load
- [ ] *Not run:* the deterministic replay-diff harness does not exist at this point in history (it lands later in the stack), so there is no same-seed A/B available for this slice. `-test-games-nox` seeds from `time(NULL)` and cannot be pinned here.
- [ ] *Reviewer:* Linux build — the SCons and Darwin-bundle changes are the parts most likely to regress a platform I can't test
- [ ] *Reviewer:* confirm you want `CLAUDE.md` in this repo
title: Modernize the build: SCons/Python 3, zlib fixes, boost to std
